messages:
sofia: Quick heads-up — mosaic-realtime-v1 is now GA for the Hosted API. It supports streaming + tool-calling and will start a staged production rollout next week. Docs + migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/mosaic-realtime. Please read the deprecation notes for older realtime endpoints.
jon: awesome! is streaming behavior identical to the beta? any changes to per-request limits?
sofia: mostly the same UX. key changes: improved chunked streaming (lower latencies), tool-calls are first-class, and a soft rate-limit remodel: streaming windows now default to 120s/session. Pricing model unchanged for hosted for now — tokens billed as usual.
priya: runtime note — default batching for mosaic-realtime-v1 is tuned for short-turn dialogues. If you need larger sequence perf, set batch_target_tokens in the route config. Also you can opt into the low-latency path with header X-Redwood-Low-Latency: 1.
jon: can you paste an example curl with tool-calling + streaming headers?
priya: sure
priya: ```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Redwood-Streaming-Mode: chunked" -d '{"model":"mosaic-realtime-v1","input":"Summarize this...","enable_tool_calls":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/generate
```
alex: rollout schedule? will we be flipped for all hosted customers automatically?
sofia: staged rollout: canary starts 1792003600 (4/10 10:00 UTC) at 5% traffic, 2-week observability window, then 50% on 4/17, full by 4/24 if no regressions. Hosted accounts are auto-migrated; self-serve opt-out is available via the org settings page for one week during canary. Dedicated/private customers will be contacted to schedule their migration.
alex: good. any immediate action for integrations teams?
sofia: please verify streaming clients handle chunked transfer with intermediate partial events and tool-calls. If you call out a model by name (mosaic-realtime-v1) you'll get the new behavior. If you reference generic realtime:latest we'll route to compatible variant (backward-safe). Migration checklist in the guide: small prompt set + smoke evals + trace tokens.
docs-bot: Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/mosaic-realtime#migration (includes curl examples, SDK notes, and known gotchas).
deploy-bot: rollout job 12345 queued -> started; canary cluster provisioned in us-west-2.
jon: are embeddings or standard /generate endpoints impacted?
sofia: no — embeddings and standard non-realtime generate endpoints are unchanged. This GA only affects the new realtime mosaic surface and its variants.
alex: thanks — please call out any incidents in #incidents ASAP if observability shows regression.
sofia: will do. thanks all — ping me on thread or slack DMs for questions or if you need early access to canary.
jon: congrats team! :tada:
